response.stronger_answer: I implemented a read-through caching strategy using Redis to store frequently accessed, read-only data from PostgreSQL. This bypassed expensive database queries, and by setting a short TTL and implementing a write-through mechanism, we achieved the targeted 40% reduction in API latency.
